SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: This is my own decision.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's something that I've decided to finish, with my spirit, belief and pride on the line.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: So please, speak no further.

TEXT: ...But you know, isn't this slightly different since people are worried about you?

TEXT: Isn't it natural for me, a brother, to take care of you?

TEXT: ...I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: And what of it? Isn't it better for you to back off before you get scratched?

TEXT: Yes, that's right. You're too bothersome, so I had to bare my claws.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But, despite all that pain...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It puts me a million times more at ease than seeing you fall.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Wha-...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Compared to that, your claws are just a mere plaything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I've become tough! I won't be driven away by your claws!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's why I'll use any methods to stop you the next time you're being reckless again. I hope you're prepared!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: *sigh*

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Good grief... you are such a...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I guess I won't be scratching you the next time, but biting you instead...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm quite happy if you would rather bite me. Your face will be closer to me, at least.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You're really beyond all hope...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's fine to be worry about others, but how about considering your 【Own Future】 for a bit?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then don't let me worry about you too much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But isn't that just you taking matters into your own hands?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, I guess that's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's about it. That's all I want to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll be leaving then.

If she's going to be reckless again, I'll stop her before she collapses.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hmm?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...H-Hold on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What is it?

TEXT: Hmm? What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: The... oracle just now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, what's wrong with you, Kuroneko? What oracle are you talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I would like to have a life counseling session.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Heh... Hahaha.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Stop laughing. I'm being serious.

TEXT: I'm being serious here as well. Life counseling, you say?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I never expected that from you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I've heard it long ago from her. She said it with a sense of pride too. I'm sure you'll listen to what I have to say if I were to put it this way, will you not?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: So... could you listen to my troubles?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course, bring it on!
And with that, Kuroneko's life counseling session started.
I didn't really think the situation would develop this way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I've been drawing the event's manuscript, all by myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I just want to confirm how far I could go by my own right now...

TEXT: But it seems I can't finish by the deadline if this goes on.

TEXT: That's why... could you help me out?

TEXT: Haha, isn't it the same as the suggestion I gave before?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO

TEXT: Is it all right like this? ...And? Will you accept?

TEXT: Yeah, please do.
